content_zh:
聂云这种反应，说明张野的事情不是他安排的。
也许正如聂云所说，自己和苏雪儿走的太近，那些觊觎苏雪儿的人肯定都恨死自己了。
现在临近毕业，有些心思狠毒的世家子弟，已经在想着如何对付自己。
这些人也真是恶心，有本事就堂堂正正的去追苏雪儿啊，对付自己这种穷学生算是什么事。
顾青山暗暗鄙视，不一会儿，思绪逐渐飘远。
游戏降临大概还要再过一年，这段时间是整个人类世界最后的安宁日子。
一年时间，足够自己在异世界站稳脚跟。
至于回归现实世界的这些日子，顾青山想来想去，还是觉得想呆在大学里。
大学里不但环境好，很多重要的机甲科研机构也在其中，包括军方设立的大学，有很多研发中的兵器。
第一批进入游戏的玩家，从人数上来算，也以大学的师生为多，所以这里机会也多一些。
自己可以在这里为末日的来临准备，也可以在战斗之余，在这里稍稍休整，乃至结识一些人，寻找一些特别的东西。
顾青山正想着，忽然发现对面的街道，走过来五六个醉醺醺的青年。
这几名青年的身上纹满刺青，头发染成醒目的黄色，在昏暗的路灯下摇摇晃晃的走来。
这条路上，人行道本就不宽，他们这样勾肩搭背的并排行走，立刻就占满了空间。
顾青山皱了皱眉头，索性让开道路。
双方错过的时候，不知是有意还是无意，一个黄毛青年斜着身子朝顾青山撞来。
顾青山身为修行者，又有数十年尸山血海的战斗经验，怎会被一个普通人撞上。
他身子随便一侧，就和对方错开了身位。
黄毛青年踉跄着冲出去几步，这才站稳身子。
见鬼，居然被他躲开了，黄毛青年回头骂道：“你小子敢撞我？兄弟们，揍他！”

话音刚落，几名青年脸上的朦胧醉意消失的干干净净。
“动手！”
几人低喝一声，摸出身上的匕首，冲了上来。
“原来如此。”顾青山见状，顿时明白了。
这几个人，明显是冲他来的。
真要是喝醉了打架，绝不会轻易动刀子。
就算有一个人喝多了脑子不清醒，也不可能每个人都是如此。
几名青年行动很迅速，一息的功夫，第一个人已经冲了上来，挥着匕首猛刺顾青山的心窝。
这一刀又快又狠，要是刺中了，直接就是一刀毙命。
是专业人士！
顾青山心中一跳，急速掠进几步，让过匕首，突入对方怀中。
“喝！”
他张开五指，一掌将对方拍回去。
那人打着旋儿倒飞出去，撞上后面跟上来的几人。
几名小混混就像被飞奔的公牛撞在腰上，齐齐爆发出一声痛苦难当的惨嚎，统统滚落在地上，一时呻吟不止。
再看那名被扇飞的小混混，胸口凹陷下去一大片，早没了气息。
顾青山见状，也是怔了怔。
“竟然忘了，现在还不是末世……”他喃喃道。
唯一还站着的那名青年，强抑住心中的寒意，厉声吼道：“掏家伙！”
一掌就扇死了自己这边的武者，还把后面紧跟而来的几人全部撞倒在地，这需要何等的力量。

开玩笑，自己这几名同伙，好歹都是一星二星武者，居然瞬间就被打趴在地上，连行动的力量都没有了。
这简直是个怪物！
更让人恐惧的是，自己连对方怎么移动的，都没有看清。
如此可怕的实力，恐怕对方至少都是七星以上的武者。
兴许是突破了九星桎梏的武道宗师，也是有可能的。
他却不知，顾青山只是一时忘了留手，将灵力附着在了手掌上。
炼气二层的修行者，若不动用灵力，身体的素质只相当于四星武者。
但动用了灵力，那就不一样了，破坏能力放大了几倍。
几名青年脸上的颜色全变了，纷纷摸出枪来。
原本是打算制造一场酒后斗殴、伤人致死的意外，这样的话，谁都查不出个什么。
谁知道这人看上去只是个不起眼的学生，动起手来如此凶猛！
这样的情况下，再也顾不上原本的计划，唯有先杀了对方再说。
顾青山看见他们的动作，瞬间明白过来。
一张弓凭空出现在他手中。
他的动作远比这些人快！
啪啪啪啪啪！
顾青山双手化作残影，刹那之间射出六支箭矢。
五人几乎分不出先后，均被一箭射爆了头颅。

content_en:
Nie Yun's reaction showed that Zhang Ye's matter was not arranged by him.
Perhaps as Nie Yun said, he and Amelia Su are too close, and those who covet Amelia Su must hate him.
Now that graduation is approaching, some vicious-minded children from aristocratic families are already thinking about how to deal with themselves.
These people are really disgusting. If they have the ability, they will pursue Su Xueer in an upright manner. How can they deal with a poor student like me?
Gu Qingshan secretly despised it, and after a while, his thoughts gradually drifted away.
It will probably be another year before the game comes. This period will be the last peaceful days for the entire human world.
One year is enough time to establish a foothold in a different world.
As for the days when he returned to the real world, after much thought, Gu Qingshan still felt that he wanted to stay in college.
Not only does the university have a good environment, but there are also many important mecha research institutions, including universities established by the military, which have many weapons under development.
In terms of number, the first batch of players to enter the game are mostly teachers and students from the university, so there are more opportunities here.
You can prepare for the end of the world here, or you can take a break here after fighting, or even get to know some people and look for something special.
Gu Qingshan was thinking when he suddenly noticed five or six drunken youths walking towards the opposite street.
These young men, with their bodies covered in tattoos and their hair dyed eye-catching yellow, staggered under the dim street lights.
The sidewalk on this road was not wide. They walked side by side, arm in arm, and immediately filled up the space.
Gu Qingshan frowned and simply got out of the way.
When the two sides missed each other, whether intentionally or not, a young man with yellow hair leaned towards Gu Qingshan.
As a cultivator, Gu Qingshan had decades of fighting experience in mountains of corpses and seas of blood, how could he be bumped into by an ordinary person.
If he turned to one side, he would be out of position with the other person.
The yellow-haired young man staggered out and took a few steps before regaining his balance.
Damn it, he actually dodged it. The yellow-haired young man turned around and cursed: "How dare you hit me? Brothers, beat him!"
As soon as the words fell, the hazy drunkenness on the faces of several young people completely disappeared.
"Do it!"
Several people shouted low, took out the daggers on their bodies, and rushed forward.
"That's it." When Gu Qingshan saw this, he immediately understood.
These people were obviously coming for him.
If he really got into a fight when he was drunk, he would never use a knife easily.
Even if one person drinks too much and loses his mind, it cannot be the case for everyone.
The young men moved very quickly. In the blink of an eye, the first one rushed up and stabbed Gu Qingshan in the heart with a dagger.
This knife is fast and hard. If it hits, it will kill him directly.
Be a professional!
Gu Qingshan's heart skipped a beat, he quickly took a few steps forward, passed the dagger, and rushed into the opponent's arms.
"Drink!"
He spread his fingers and slapped the opponent back with one palm.
The man flew out in a spin and bumped into several people following him.
The few gangsters were like being hit on the waist by a galloping bull, and they all let out an unbearable howl of pain, and they all rolled to the ground, moaning for a while.
Looking at the little gangster who was slapped away, his chest was greatly sunken and he had long since lost his breath.
When Gu Qingshan saw this, he was also startled.
"I actually forgot that it's not the end of the world yet..." he murmured.
The only young man still standing suppressed the chill in his heart and shouted sternly: "Get it!"
He slapped the warrior on his side to death with one palm, and also knocked all the people following him to the ground. What kind of strength was needed.
Just kidding, several of my accomplices, who were all one- and two-star warriors after all, were beaten to the ground in an instant, without even the strength to move.
What a monster!
What's even more frightening is that I didn't even see how the other person moved.
in this wayWith terrible strength, I am afraid that the opponents are at least seven-star warriors or above.
Maybe he is a martial arts master who has broken through the shackles of the Nine Stars. It is also possible.
Little did he know that Gu Qingshan just forgot to keep his hand and attached his spiritual power to his palm.
If a practitioner on the second level of Qi Refining does not use spiritual power, his physical quality is only equivalent to that of a four-star warrior.
But when spiritual power is used, it's different. The destructive ability is magnified several times.
The colors on the faces of several young men changed completely, and they all took out guns.
The original plan was to cause a drunken brawl and fatal accident, so that no one would be able to find out anything.
Who knew that this person, who looked like an inconspicuous student, could act so fiercely!
Under such circumstances, the original plan can no longer be taken into consideration, and the only choice is to kill the opponent first.
Gu Qingshan saw their actions and understood instantly.
A bow appeared out of thin air in his hand.
His movements are much faster than these people!
Bang bang bang bang bang!
Gu Qingshan's hands turned into afterimages and shot six arrows in an instant.
It was almost impossible to tell the order of the five people, and they were all shot to the head with an arrow.
